newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA RAND RETREATS FROM 4.70 AS DOLLAR SAGS.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA RAND RETREATS FROM 4.70 AS DOLLAR SAGS.

text.p: 1230 GMT - Rand holds below 4.70 in early afternoon as dollar retraces back below 1.88 on mark, triggering local and offshore profit-taking. Bonds amble in post close-out trade.

* Rand at 4.6935/6965 on dlr from 4.6715/6745 at 1400 GMT on Wednesday. Dealers say trade quiet and all eyes on dollar which last trading at around 1.8770. Reserve Bank seen on the offer earlier at 4.70 to 4.7050, dealers say.
* Rand seen holding current levels for rest of day, but could pop back over 4.70 if dollar rallies again.
* Rand/sterling benefits from cable weakness after Bank of England hikes interest rates by 25 basis points. Last at 7.4713/4807.
* R150 holds at 14.09 pct from 14.00 pct close as market searches for fresh direction in wake of noon close-out and players reassess positions. Range of 14.10 to 14.00 pct expected for rest of day.
